scope: Prospective correction of the standard-LoRA initialization-seed policy in the conditional two-seed paper-baseline plan. This artifact does not change or authorize the active Phase-1 controller, I0/I8 allocations, training, evaluation, or gate.

known: The active I0/I8 allocations use one fixed complement draw with complement_seed 42.
unobserved: All protocol-matched standard-LoRA-r32 training and evaluation results.

corrected_artifact.old_policy: Do not introduce an extra initializer seed or seed-dependent direction construction. Use the same worker/model initialization path as Phase 1; training-seed variation remains the fixed data-loader and rollout seed variation.
corrected_artifact.reason_for_correction: The current standard-LoRA code path calls PEFT get_peft_model without explicitly seeding the RNG that initializes LoRA A. The configured FSDP engine seed is not applied when full_determinism is false, and FSDP sync_module_states only synchronizes ranks within one run. Therefore the old policy does not guarantee equal initial A tensors across training seeds.

active_training_launcher.finding: DATA_SEED, PPO_DATA_LOADER_SEED, and ROLLOUT_SEED are configurable, but no standard-LoRA initialization seed is passed.

legacy_fsdp_worker.finding: The lora branch constructs LoraConfig and calls get_peft_model directly; no scoped RNG seed is applied before PEFT initializes A. FSDP later uses sync_module_states=true, which is intra-run synchronization only.

engine_fsdp_worker.finding: The reorganized FSDP path has the same direct LoraConfig/get_peft_model behavior. It calls enable_full_determinism only when full_determinism is true.

fsdp_engine_config.finding: A configured but unapplied seed is not evidence that PEFT A is reproducible across separate runs.

corrected_policy.required_initial_state_relation: The standard-LoRA-r32 runs for training seeds 42 and 43 must start from bitwise-identical LoRA A and B tensors. A uses the PEFT 0.19.1 default Kaiming-uniform rule under init seed 42; B is exactly zero.
corrected_policy.rng_scope: Apply the seed only in a forked/scoped RNG context immediately around standard PEFT LoRA construction, then restore the outer CPU/device RNG states. Do not enable global full_determinism merely to initialize LoRA.
corrected_policy.method_isolation: DATA_SEED, PPO_DATA_LOADER_SEED, and ROLLOUT_SEED remain equal to the training seed. The fixed init seed isolates on-policy training-trajectory variation, matching the fixed-allocation I0/I8 design.
forbidden: Using TRAIN_SEED as the standard-LoRA initialization seed.
Leaving standard-LoRA A initialization to an unrecorded process RNG state.
Changing PEFT init_lora_weights away from its default true value.
Reusing the fixed init-seed comparison as evidence of initialization-seed robustness.

implementation_requirements_after_activa: Add an explicit standard-LoRA-only initialization-seed field; do not change active grad_subspace initialization semantics.
Use a scoped RNG helper around every supported standard-LoRA get_peft_model construction path and restore the caller RNG state afterward.
Before optimizer construction or the first rollout, export or hash the complete initial LoRA A/B state in a canonical tensor order.
Store init seed, PEFT version, initializer semantics, per-tensor shapes/dtypes, canonical initial-state hash, and B-zero verification in each immutable training contract.
Require seed-42 and seed-43 standard-LoRA contracts to have the same canonical initial-state hash before accepting either comparison.
required_tests_before_real_results: Two constructions with init seed 42 produce bitwise-identical A/B tensors and canonical hashes.
Changing only training seed metadata from 42 to 43 does not change initial A/B tensors.
Changing init seed from 42 to 43 changes at least one A tensor while every B tensor remains exactly zero.
The scoped initializer restores outer CPU and relevant device RNG states.
All distributed ranks agree on the canonical initial-state hash.
A missing init seed, mismatched cross-run initial-state hash, nonzero B, unexpected PEFT version, or changed initializer source hash fails closed.

claim_boundary.purpose: This correction makes the matched standard-LoRA comparison symmetric with the fixed-allocation I0/I8 training-seed experiment.
claim_boundary.not_covered: It does not test standard-LoRA or I8 robustness to initialization seed and does not broaden any fixed-model/task claim.

execution_policy.earliest_code_change: Only after the active Phase-1 controller terminates.
execution_policy.earliest_training: Only after the I8 two-seed fixed-model/task gate activates the matched baseline and the corrected initializer tests and contracts pass.
